title: Hide Administrator role option until allowlisted phone number is entered

requirements.summary: Hide the Administrator role option by default and reveal it only when the phone number input normalizes to 91980115950 (digits-only match).
acceptanceCriteria: When the phone number input is empty or does not normalize to 91980115950, the Administrator radio option is not rendered/visible in the role selection list.
When the phone number input normalizes to 91980115950 (e.g., entered as "(91)980115950" or "91980115950"), the Administrator option becomes visible without requiring a page refresh.
Phone matching is performed using digits-only comparison (ignore parentheses and any non-digits).

file_operations.description: Update the role selection UI to conditionally render the Administrator option only when the Phone Number input digits normalize to 91980115950, using digits-only comparison (e.g., via existing phone utils). Ensure the UI reacts immediately on input changes. This dialog is part of the authorization component’s profile/role setup flow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make phone number input available before role selection and keep role/admin verification actions consistent when the admin option re-hides.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can access the phone number input without first needing to select a specific role, so they can unlock the Administrator option.

If the user has selected the Administrator role and then edits the phone number so it no longer matches 91980115950, the UI automatically deselects Administrator (switch to a non-admin role) and hides the Administrator option again.
No backend calls to admin verification/allowlisting are possible unless the Administrator role is visible and selected.

file_operations.description: Reorder/adjust the form so the Phone Number input is always visible before the role RadioGroup. Add state management to prevent inconsistent selection: if the phone no longer matches, automatically switch away from 'admin', clear admin-password UI/state, and hide the admin option again. Add a submission guard so admin verification/allowlisting mutations can only run when the admin option is currently visible/unlocked and selected. This dialog is part of the authorization component’s role-based access flow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
